target: Orange Pi PC / Allwinner H3 / 1 GB / armhf
tested_runtime: Cloud Debian 13 x86_64; Python 3.13; Chromium; isolated nginx 1.26.3

webkit_checks.native_armhf_packages: Ubuntu Resolute main/universe package indexes include gir1.2-webkit-6.0 2.52.0-1, GTK4 4.22.2, Cage 0.2.1 and media packages
webkit_checks.actual_gi_import: passed with extracted Debian WebKitGTK 2.52.6 and GTK4 4.18.6 libraries on x86_64; no host package installation
webkit_checks.actual_settings: passed on Xvfb: no page cache/devtools, autoplay without gesture, software compositing, WebsitePolicies.ALLOW, document-viewer context
webkit_checks.full_webview_render: not run: cloud user namespaces have read-only UID mapping and isolated library libexec paths are not installed into the host OS
webkit_checks.cage_output_management: upstream Cage v0.2.1 exposes wlr-output-management; installed/extracted wlr-randr 0.4.1 supports --json; actual HDMI modes not tested

passed: Current IP applied to TLS input and mobile QR configuration; custom domain and integration tokens retained
Preflight refuses x86_64/aarch64 and older OS images before service changes
Kiosk navigation denies remote origins, local administration and file URIs
HDMI selector never invents a mode not advertised by the monitor
720p lite browser profile and holiday/weekend preview controls checked without page errors
Real nginx HTTPS CA/SAN validation, secure cookies and blocked remote local-token bootstrap
Python/Ruff/shell/JavaScript and generated systemd unit syntax
Source defaults contain no role keys or integration tokens; known sample sync URLs removed
not_run: Full privileged apt/systemd/PAM/Armbian installation on the physical Orange Pi
Full GTK/WebKit child-process rendering and media in the final Cage session
Windows PowerShell execution and Windows certificate trust UI
Physical HDMI/audio/video performance, actual RAM use and CPU temperature
The users SSH/firewall/router security, power loss or SD-card faults
Active scanning or sustained load on the physical board
release_verification: Build verifies source and ZIP CRC/per-file SHA256; unpacked verification recorded alongside the published artifact metadata.
